test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which organisation with its headquarters in Kolkata and 16 regional stations is responsible for surveying the faunal resources of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zoological Survey of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI)** is in charge of surveying India's faunal resources, with headquarters in Kolkata and 16 regional stations.
 
• India's 92,037 species of fauna, of which 61,375 are insects, reflect the country's diverse climate and physical circumstances.
 
• In India alone, it is predicted that approximately twice that many species are yet to be discovered.
 
• **The Asiatic Society of Bengal was** founded by Sir William Jones on 15 January 1784.
 
• Not only was the Asiatic Society of Bengal the mother institution of the Indian Museum (1875), but also of the Zoological Survey of India and the Geological Survey of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Botanical Survey of India (BSI)** is a government organization based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. On February 13, 1890, it was established.
 
• **The Animal Welfare Board of India**, based in Ballabhgarh, Haryana, is a statutory advisory body that advises the Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry, and Dairy in India. The AWBI's previous headquarters were in Chennai.
 
• **The National Institute of Animal Welfare (NIAW) **is part of India's Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairy (Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairy). It's in the **Haryana **town of Ballabgarh.
